readings.Aries: Something is beginning. You felt it before you understood it. Don't wait for the signal — you are the signal. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Taurus: Your care for the physical world — spaces, objects, bodies — is a form of love. Extend it inward. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Gemini: The version of events in your head is more interesting than what actually happened. Check the facts. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Cancer: The dream you're not taking seriously is the dream you should take seriously. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Leo: You are at your best when you have something to offer. Today, what are you offering? The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: The criticism forming in your mind — apply it to the problem, not the person. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Libra: You've been giving people the benefit of the doubt past the point where the doubt is informative. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: Someone is being more honest with you than you're comfortable with. The discomfort is useful. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: The fire in you is generative and occasionally destructive. Today, mind the surroundings. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Capricorn: There is a risk worth taking that your caution has been routing around. Take it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Aquarius: The revolution you believe in is needed. The cost of it, for the people around you, is worth acknowledging. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Pisces: The creative thing you abandoned because the practical thing required attention — the practical thing can wait one hour. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
